$comment: Traceability: runs and provider_sessions table contracts, the provider start/resume transaction rule, and the contract-map row 'controller lease, generation fencing' (data-model.md; control-core-unification.md §4). Assigns one turn to the worker. Replaces the PoC executeTask(task, changed, control, conversation) arguments: everything the worker needs arrives here, because over IPC it can no longer read the service's in-memory objects. The worker asserts expected_binding against its environment before driving the turn (fail-closed; the PoC's assert block, moved across the seam). Binding verification against the recorded provider_sessions row happens service-side before this message is sent. One turn at a time per worker; turn.start while a turn is active is rejected with turn_in_progress.

msg_type.description: Wire discriminator: names the message type. Added in the Phase 1 edit (2026-09-18); the Phase 0 schemas pinned no discriminator, and service.error already used "message" for human-readable text, so routing on "message" was impossible.

generation.description: Turn generation. Every subsequent worker message carries it; stale generations are rejected, never retried.

agent_context.description: Replaces control.agentContext: owner-configured agent instructions prepended to the prompt. 0-8 KiB.

expected_binding.description: The exact execution binding the worker must assert before starting (PoC: image digest, store instance, model, policy digest asserts). Mismatch: refuse the turn, append run.failed.

inputs_manifest.description: Workspace files and task inputs the worker restores into the container (PoC: [...conversation.workspace, ...task.inputs]). Fetched by digest via worker.inputs.fetch.

lease_generation.description: Current controller-lease generation the turn runs under.

staging_dir.description: Service-created, run-scoped staging directory for artifact output bytes. Worker-writable, service-readable.

turn_timeout_ms.description: Hard wall-clock budget for the turn; the worker treats expiry as cancellation.

title: service.turn.start
